settings.categorical_preprocessing: explicit missing category; training one-hot encoder; unknown levels ignored
settings.cv_caution: clustering targets were developed using all development countries; this is prediction of that fixed taxonomy, not a fully nested discovery evaluation
settings.evaluation_weights: equal country, relative WGT retained, recomputed within evaluation population
settings.fitting_weights: equal country, relative WGT retained, mean weight rescaled to one
settings.heldout_uncertainty: 1000 uniform country bootstrap draws; fixed predictions and models
settings.holdout_role: supervised test outside selection; already used for Objective 1 validation
settings.interpretation: 3 joint block permutations per fold on selected model; within-country for individual blocks, across countries for income
settings.numeric_preprocessing: training equal-country-weighted median; weighted mean/SD; fixed missing indicator
settings.selection: largest mean development-fold macro-F1; exact ties prefer logistic then forest then majority
settings.tuning: none; fixed first-draft settings, not an optimized model search
